title.narrative: Actions of ASEAN Declaration for Out-of-School Children (OOSC) Phase 3

description.narrative:
Despite the considerable progress over the decades, there are still a substantial number of out-of-school children of school age in Viet Nam. The higher the level of education, the greater the share of out of school children. These children deserve stronger attention and support if Viet Nam is to ensure an equitable, inclusive quality and sustainable education for all. This project aims to increase equitable access to foundational and transferable skills and elementary vocational training development for out-of-school children (OOSC), in selected districts of two provinces, i.e., Vung Tau and Dong Thap, in Viet Nam.
The overall intervention will be carried out by: 1) mobilizing and building capacity of relevant stakeholders including without limitation to government officials, industry representatives; managers and teachers/facilitators of Community Learning Centers (CLCs) or Continuing Education and Vocational Training Centres (CEVTCs); 2) reviewing, adjusting/designing, and delivering the foundational/transferable skills and elementary vocational training programmes to cater for OOSC, as appropriate; and 3) sharing experiences broadly for further stakeholder sensitization, communication, and advocacy in ASEAN region.
